macros.name: bottomcaption
macros.doc: A command to provide a caption for the table. The caption is placed at the bottom of the table.

macros.name: tablecaption
macros.doc: A command to provide a caption for the table. The caption is placed at the default position, which is at the top of the table.

macros.name: tablefirsthead
macros.doc: Defines the contents of the first occurence of the tabular head.

macros.name: tablehead
macros.doc: Defines the contents of the table head on subsequent pages.

macros.name: tablelasthead
macros.doc: Defines the contents of the table head on the last page of the table.

macros.name: tablelasttail
macros.doc: The contents of this command are inserted before the final (internal) \end{tabular} of the table.

macros.name: tabletail
macros.doc: The contents of this command are inserted before the (internal) \end{tabular} on each page except for the last page of the table.

macros.name: topcaption
macros.doc: A command to provide a caption for the table. The caption is placed at the top of the table.

envs.name: mpxtabular
envs.doc: Like the xtabular environment except that each ‘page’ is put into a minipage first.

envs.name: xtabular
envs.doc: Unlike the tabular environment which prevents page breaking within the tabular, the xtabular allows page breaking, so that tabulars can extend automatically across several pages. xtabular starts off with a tabular environment and checks the amount of space left on the page as it adds each row to the tabulation.
